function.name: user_authentication_login
function.description: Authenticates a user based on their username and password. It returns an authentication token if credentials are valid. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

remember_me.description: Whether to keep the user logged in for an extended period.

login_attempts.description: The number of unsuccessful login attempts before displaying a captcha.

message.content: Untuk dapat memeriksa ketersediaan produk, saya perlu memastikan bahwa Anda memiliki akses yang sah ke sistem kami. Mohon masukkan nama pengguna dan kata sandi Anda (atau beri tahu saya jika Anda ingin menggunakan opsi “remember me”). Setelah saya dapatkan token otentikasi, saya akan dapat memeriksa status produk tersebut.
message.reasoning: The user asks in Indonesian: "Apakah produk ini masih ada?" meaning "Is this product still available?" We need to authenticate? The user didn't provide credentials. The system says we can only respond if we have a valid authentication token. So we need to ask for credentials or attempt to authenticate? The user didn't provide username/password. We cannot proceed. According to policy, we must not reveal policy. We should ask for credentials. The user might want to know if product is available. But we can't answer without authentication. So we should ask for username and password.
